question:
Select the figure from the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eec70d8b95315f6a08dc4f996a72f1a53e279e5d4f99f4a93a4d41f24cb45de2.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Step I: The arrow and rhombus are getting exchanged and flipped in all alternate images.

Step II: The arrow and rhombus are getting exchanged with it's place in all alternate images.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d6349e693ee49f740b01b31ade8e0f0676726447d9f112fbce2ee107e59c7377.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.
